_help: Your own church directory, shown with a 'Listed' badge in the church finder at /churches/ alongside OpenStreetMap results.
Fields: name (required), address (required unless lat and lng are given), city, country, denomination, website, phone, serviceTimes, notes, lat, lng, enabled (false hides it).
Addresses are located automatically at build time (OpenStreetMap geocoding) and the result is cached. Give lat/lng directly for precision.
Manage this list from gloriousanchor.com/admin/ under Churches.
